description: A PHP class defining a binary expression node for bitwise AND operation within the Twig template engine's abstract syntax tree (AST). It extends AbstractBinary and overrides the operator method to output the '&' operator during compilation.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\BitwiseAndBinary
classes.description: A class representing a bitwise AND binary expression node in Twig's AST, generating the '&' operator during compilation.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the compiler object with the raw '&' operator appended for this binary expression.
